questions.prompt: Button versus big blind, you have AK on A72 rainbow. Best default?

choices.text: Bet for value. Top pair, top kicker is ahead of the calling range.
Check because an ace hits the caller
All-in for 100 big blinds as the only value bet

questions.explanation: This is a value bet, usually a smaller size on a dry board, not a check and not a stack-off size.

questions.prompt: Same pot, you have 76 with no pair and no draw on A72 rainbow. Best default?

choices.text: Check back. You have little equity and little fold equity against a hand that called an ace-high board.
Bet large because you were the raiser

questions.explanation: Being the raiser is not a reason to fire air into a board that already favors you with better hands.

questions.prompt: Button versus big blind, you have a set on 9h 8h 6c. Best default?

choices.text: Bet larger. You want calls from draws and worse made hands.
Check back so the draws see a free card
Bet the minimum and fold to a raise

questions.explanation: A set on a wet board wants a bigger pot. Giving a free card lets flushes and straights catch up.

questions.prompt: In position with a medium pocket pair that did not set, on a king-high dry board, a sound line is…

choices.text: Check back and reevaluate the turn.
Bet pot and call a check-raise

questions.explanation: Underpairs have showdown value against ace-high and missed hands. They do not want a huge pot.
